model_annotation:
The figure contains two side-by-side line plots that illustrate the relationship between two different hyperparameters and BLEU score.

The left plot shows BLEU score as a function of the hyperparameter α. The x-axis represents α on a linear scale, with tick labels at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9. The y-axis represents BLEU score on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 28.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. A single blue solid line with circular markers traces the relationship. The line begins at approximately 27.99 at α = 0.1, rises to approximately 28.33 at α = 0.3, reaches a peak of approximately 28.53 at α = 0.5, then declines to approximately 28.40 at α = 0.7, and further decreases to approximately 28.12 at α = 0.9.

The right plot shows BLEU score as a function of the hyperparameter p. The x-axis represents p on a linear scale, with tick labels at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45. The y-axis represents BLEU score on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 28.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. A single blue solid line with circular markers traces the relationship. The line starts at approximately 28.31 at p = 0.05, rises to a peak of approximately 28.53 at p = 0.15, then drops to approximately 28.42 at p = 0.25, increases slightly to approximately 28.47 at p = 0.35, and decreases to approximately 28.43 at p = 0.45.
